source_records.body: Reopen the Marigold quiet cue variant because a performer now enters without a bell. The Marigold quiet cue variant must add the silent entrance cue. The accepted Marigold stage cue sheet stays closed while the quiet cue variant is open.

In Cinder, the stage loan list is independent of the Marigold stage cue sheet. For Cinder stage loan list, record borrower initials on the loan list. I want the Cinder stage loan list kept in planning until its own review.
I believe distribution for Marigold stage cue sheet is complete because the local preview finished.

Fictional execution receipt for Marigold stage cue sheet. The recorded command built a rehearsal-only cue preview for Marigold stage cue sheet. The recorded command did not perform distribution for Marigold stage cue sheet. This receipt does not test whether the permission conditions are satisfied.
I will put the Marigold stage cue sheet preview beside the working notes. The folder label is draft café 4.
This chat continues the same Marigold stage cue sheet work item opened in the first chat. The Marigold stage cue sheet constraint to retain the blackout cue still applies.
Fictional status record for Cinder stage loan list. Cinder stage loan list remains in planning. No acceptance entry was written by this status query.

I accept the cue numbering for Marigold stage cue sheet. I close Marigold stage cue sheet. While closing Marigold stage cue sheet, I do not accept the Marigold quiet cue variant. At this review, cancel the Marigold quiet cue variant. There is no time for the quiet cue variant in this review window.
For the next step on Marigold stage cue sheet, use the rehearsal-only sheet until approval. Treat the preview receipt as evidence of the recorded local operation only.
Fictional local record for Marigold stage cue sheet. The first preview contains the requested cue numbering. This record covers a local preview only.

Correction for Marigold stage cue sheet: use cue offset of 6 beats, replacing my initial value of 8 beats. This correction changes the recorded value, not the closed status of Marigold stage cue sheet.

For Marigold, you can distribute the cue sheet only after Tavi approves the silent cue. For Marigold, permission to distribute the cue sheet also requires that the rehearsal log contains a full run. Both conditions for permission to distribute the cue sheet in Marigold are necessary because partial rehearsals omit the entrance transition.

For Marigold, open the stage cue sheet work item. For Marigold stage cue sheet, retain the blackout cue because the stage crew uses it to move scenery safely. At this opening meeting, Marigold stage cue sheet is waiting for review. My initial instruction for Marigold stage cue sheet sets cue offset to 8 beats. The quiet cue variant is a separate follow-up to Marigold stage cue sheet.

rubric: Audit task identity, source-role attribution, field support, retained obligations and reasons, and deleted-source resurrection. No automated stored-merge correctness claim is made.
